title: Spaghetti tomato basil
description: Classic spaghetti with tomato, garlic, and basil.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Heat olive oil and sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add tomato, salt, and black pepper; simmer 10 minutes.
Toss spaghetti with the sauce and basil.
Serve with parmesan.

title: Penne arrabbiata
description: Spicy tomato penne with garlic and oregano.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Heat olive oil and sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Stir in tomato and tomato paste; simmer 12 minutes.
Season with oregano, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Toss penne with sauce and serve.

title: Farfalle pesto
description: Farfalle tossed with basil pesto and parmesan.
steps: Boil farfalle in salted water until al dente.
Blend basil, olive oil, garlic, walnuts, parmesan, and salt into a pesto.
Reserve a splash of pasta water.
Toss farfalle with pesto, loosening with pasta water as needed.
Serve immediately.

title: Creamy mushroom spaghetti
description: Spaghetti with mushrooms in a creamy garlic sauce.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Melt butter and sauté mushrooms until browned.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Pour in heavy cream; simmer 3 minutes.
Toss spaghetti with sauce, parmesan, parsley, salt, and black pepper.

title: Spinach ricotta penne
description: Quick penne with spinach and ricotta-style creamy sauce.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Heat olive oil and sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Stir in sour cream, salt, and black pepper.
Toss penne with sauce and finish with parmesan.

title: Garlic butter pasta
description: Simple pasta coated in garlic butter and parsley.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Melt butter and gently sauté garlic for 45 seconds.
Add parsley, salt, and black pepper.
Toss spaghetti with garlic butter and serve.

title: Lemon parmesan spaghetti
description: Bright spaghetti with lemon, olive oil, and parmesan.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Warm olive oil with garlic for 30 seconds.
Add lemon juice and a splash of pasta water.
Toss spaghetti with sauce, parmesan, salt, and black pepper.
Finish with parsley.

title: Tomato tuna pasta
description: Penne with tomato sauce and tuna.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato and oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in tuna and heat through.
Toss pasta with sauce and serve.

title: Baked cheese pasta
description: Oven-baked pasta with tomato and melted mozzarella.
steps: Boil penne 2 minutes less than al dente; drain.
Simmer tomato, tomato paste, olive oil, garlic, oregano, and salt for 10 minutes.
Mix pasta with sauce and transfer to a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200В°C until bubbling and lightly browned.

title: Broccoli garlic spaghetti
description: Spaghetti with broccoli, garlic, and olive oil.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Blanch broccoli in the same pot for 2 minutes; drain.
Heat olive oil and sauté garlic with red pepper flakes.
Toss spaghetti and broccoli with the garlic oil.
Season and serve with parmesan.

title: Creamy tomato penne
description: Penne in tomato sauce finished with heavy cream.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Sauté onion in olive oil until soft.
Add tomato and simmer 12 minutes; season.
Stir in heavy cream and basil.
Toss penne with sauce and serve.

title: Chicken pasta skillet
description: Penne with chicken breast, tomato, and garlic.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Brown chicken breast in olive oil; season with salt and black pepper.
Add onion and cook until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato and oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Toss penne with the skillet sauce and serve.

title: Shrimp garlic spaghetti
description: Spaghetti with shrimp, garlic, lemon, and olive oil.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil for 30 seconds.
Add shrimp and cook until just pink; season.
Add lemon juice and a splash of pasta water.
Toss spaghetti with shrimp and finish with parsley.

title: Vegetable pasta primavera
description: Pasta with bell pepper, zucchini, and tomato.
steps: Boil farfalle in salted water until al dente.
Sauté bell pepper and zucchini in olive oil until tender-crisp.
Add garlic and tomato; cook 5 minutes.
Season with salt and toss with pasta.
Finish with basil.

title: Pasta carbonara style
description: Creamy egg and parmesan pasta with bacon.
steps: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve pasta water.
Cook bacon until crisp.
Whisk eggs with parmesan and black pepper.
Toss hot pasta with bacon, then quickly mix in egg mixture off heat.
Loosen with a splash of pasta water and serve.

title: Sausage tomato penne
description: Penne with sausage and quick tomato sauce.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Brown sausage in olive oil; break into pieces.
Add onion until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato and oregano; simmer 12 minutes; season with salt.
Toss with penne and serve.

title: Basil tomato farfalle
description: Farfalle with tomato, basil, and olive oil.
steps: Boil farfalle in salted water until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil for 30 seconds.
Add tomato, salt, and black pepper; cook 8 minutes.
Toss farfalle with sauce and basil.
Serve warm.

title: Beef meatballs in tomato sauce
description: Ground beef meatballs simmered in tomato sauce.
steps: Mix ground beef with grated onion, garlic, egg, flour, salt, and black pepper.
Form meatballs and brown them in olive oil.
Add tomato and tomato paste; simmer 20 minutes.
Return meatballs to sauce and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken breast with garlic butter
description: Pan-seared chicken breast finished with garlic butter.
steps: Season chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Sear in olive oil until browned and cooked through.
Add butter and garlic; baste for 1 minute.
Finish with parsley.
Rest 3 minutes before slicing.

title: Pork chops with mustard sauce
description: Juicy pork chops with a quick mustard cream sauce.
steps: Season pork with salt and black pepper.
Sear in olive oil until browned and cooked through.
Remove pork; melt butter in the pan.
Stir in mustard and heavy cream; simmer 2 minutes.
Serve pork with sauce.

title: Beef and potato skillet
description: Ground beef cooked with potato, onion, and spices.
steps: Dice potato and sauté in olive oil until golden.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Season with paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Chicken and rice bowl
description: Simple chicken breast and rice with garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Cook rice until tender.
Sauté chicken breast in olive oil until cooked through.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in soy sauce and black pepper.
Serve chicken over rice.

title: Sausage and bell pepper skillet
description: Sausage cooked with bell pepper and onion.
steps: Brown sausage pieces in olive oil.
Add onion and bell pepper; cook until tender.
Season with oregano, salt, and black pepper.
Cook 2 more minutes to combine flavors.
Serve hot.

title: Baked chicken with potato
description: Oven-baked chicken breast with potato and rosemary.
steps: Preheat oven to 200В°C.
Toss potato with olive oil, rosemary, salt, and black pepper.
Add chicken breast and garlic to the tray; drizzle with olive oil.
Bake until chicken is cooked through and potato is tender.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

title: Beef chili with beans
description: Hearty ground beef chili with beans and tomato.
steps: Cook onion and garlic until fragrant.
Add ground beef and brown well.
Stir in tomato and tomato paste; simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans, paprika, cumin, and salt; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Turkey-style meat patties
description: Quick pan-fried meat patties using ground beef and onion.
steps: Mix ground beef with grated onion, egg, flour, salt, and black pepper.
Shape into patties.
Pan-fry in olive oil until browned and cooked through.
Rest 2 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Honey garlic chicken
description: Chicken breast glazed with honey and soy sauce.
steps: Sear chicken breast in olive oil until cooked through.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Stir in honey, soy sauce, and vinegar.
Simmer until glossy and coating the chicken.
Serve hot.

title: Pork and cabbage stir-fry
description: Fast pork and cabbage with soy sauce and garlic.
steps: Slice pork thinly and season with black pepper and a pinch of salt.
Sauté onion in olive oil until soft.
Add pork and cook until browned.
Add cabbage and garlic; stir-fry until tender.
Add soy sauce, toss, and serve.

title: Bacon and egg breakfast plate
description: Crispy bacon with fried eggs.
steps: Cook bacon until crisp.
Fry eggs in the rendered bacon fat.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef and mushroom pan
description: Ground beef cooked with mushrooms and onion.
steps: Sauté onion and mushrooms in butter and olive oil until browned.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Cook 2 more minutes and serve.

title: Chicken tomato stew
description: Chicken breast simmered in tomato with onion and garlic.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add chicken breast pieces and brown lightly.
Add tomato and thyme; season.
Simmer until chicken is tender and sauce thickens.
Serve hot.

title: Sausage rice skillet
description: Rice cooked with sausage, onion, and tomato.
steps: Brown sausage in olive oil.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Add rice and toast 1 minute.
Add tomato and enough water to cook rice; season with paprika and salt.
Simmer until rice is tender.

title: Pork with garlic and soy sauce
description: Quick pork strips with garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Slice pork into thin strips.
Sear in olive oil until browned.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add soy sauce and black pepper; toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

title: Beef taco bowl
description: Seasoned ground beef served over rice with tomato and lettuce.
steps: Cook rice until tender.
Brown ground beef with onion in olive oil.
Season with cumin, paprika, and salt.
Chop tomato and lettuce.
Assemble bowls with rice, beef, tomato, and lettuce.

title: Chickpea curry with tomato
description: Chickpeas simmered with tomato, onion, and spices.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato, cumin, paprika, and salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Add chickpeas and simmer 15 minutes.
Adjust seasoning and serve.

title: Lentil stew with carrot
description: Lentils cooked with carrot, onion, and tomato.
steps: Sauté onion and carrot in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add lentils, tomato, thyme, salt, and water.
Simmer until lentils are tender.
Serve hot.

title: Vegetable fried rice
description: Rice stir-fried with peas, carrot, and soy sauce.
steps: Heat olive oil and sauté onion and carrot until tender.
Add peas and cook 2 minutes.
Push vegetables aside and scramble eggs in the pan.
Add cooked rice and soy sauce; toss well.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Mushroom risotto style
description: Creamy rice with mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Sauté onion and mushrooms in butter until browned.
Stir in rice and cook 1 minute.
Add hot water gradually, stirring until rice is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Finish with parmesan.

title: Tomato cucumber salad bowl
description: Fresh salad with tomato, cucumber, and olive oil.
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, and onion.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Toss and serve.

title: Roasted vegetables tray
description: Roasted bell pepper, zucchini, and eggplant with herbs.
steps: Preheat oven to 200В°C.
Cut vegetables into chunks and toss with olive oil, herbs, and salt.
Spread on a tray in a single layer.
Roast until tender and lightly browned.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Spinach omelette
description: Egg omelette with spinach and cheddar.
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and black pepper.
Melt butter in a pan and add spinach until wilted.
Pour in eggs and cook until nearly set.
Add cheddar, fold, and finish cooking.
Serve warm.

title: Vegetarian chili with beans
description: Beans and tomato simmered with onion and spices.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato, cumin, paprika, and salt; simmer 12 minutes.
Add beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Potato and mushroom sauté
description: Potato sautéed with mushrooms and onion.
steps: Dice potato and cook in olive oil until golden and tender.
Add onion and mushrooms; cook until browned.
Stir in butter, salt, and black pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Tomato mozzarella bake
description: Tomato baked with mozzarella and basil.
steps: Preheat oven to 200В°C.
Slice tomato and arrange in a baking dish.
Top with mozzarella and drizzle with olive oil.
Bake until mozzarella melts.
Finish with basil, salt, and black pepper.

title: Vegetable soup with potato
description: Light soup with potato, carrot, and celery.
steps: Chop potato, carrot, celery, and onion.
Simmer vegetables in water until tender.
Add garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Cook 5 more minutes.
Serve with parsley.

title: Broccoli cheddar bake
description: Broccoli baked with cheddar and a creamy sauce.
steps: Blanch broccoli for 2 minutes and drain.
Make a quick sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, add milk, simmer until thick.
Season sauce with salt and black pepper and stir in half the cheddar.
Combine broccoli with sauce, top with remaining cheddar.
Bake at 200В°C until bubbling.

title: Cabbage and carrot slaw
description: Crunchy cabbage and carrot slaw with yogurt dressing.
steps: Shred cabbage and grate carrot.
Whisk yogurt with mustard, vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Toss vegetables with dressing.
Chill 10 minutes and serve.

title: Eggplant tomato sauté
description: Eggplant cooked with tomato, garlic, and herbs.
steps: Dice eggplant and sauté in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add tomato, oregano, and salt; simmer 10 minutes.
Serve warm.

title: Peas and rice pilaf
description: Rice cooked with peas and butter.
steps: Cook rice until nearly tender.
Add peas and cook 5 more minutes.
Stir in butter, salt, and black pepper.
Serve warm.

title: Zucchini garlic sauté
description: Zucchini sautéed with garlic and olive oil.
steps: Slice zucchini.
Sauté in olive oil until tender.
Add garlic, salt, and black pepper; cook 1 minute.
Finish with parsley and serve.

title: Scrambled eggs with butter
description: Soft scrambled eggs finished with butter.
steps: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and black pepper.
Melt butter over low heat.
Add eggs and stir gently until softly set.
Serve immediately.

title: Classic pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with vanilla and honey.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Whisk milk, egg, and vanilla extract; combine with dry ingredients.
Cook pancakes in a lightly buttered pan until golden on both sides.
Serve with honey.

title: Oatmeal with honey and cinnamon
description: Warm oatmeal sweetened with honey and cinnamon.
steps: Simmer oats with milk and a pinch of salt until thick.
Stir in cinnamon.
Serve with honey.

title: Yogurt bowl with berries
description: Yogurt topped with blueberries and honey.
steps: Add yogurt to a bowl.
Top with blueberries and walnuts.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Avocado toast
description: Toasted bread with mashed avocado and lemon.
steps: Toast bread.
Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Spread on toast and serve.

title: Egg sandwich
description: Egg and cheddar sandwich with tomato.
steps: Toast bread lightly.
Cook eggs to your preference in butter; season with salt.
Assemble sandwich with cheddar and tomato.
Serve warm.

title: Breakfast potatoes
description: Crispy potato cubes with onion and paprika.
steps: Dice potato and cook in olive oil until golden and tender.
Add onion and cook until soft.
Season with paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Cheese omelette
description: Simple omelette with cheddar and black pepper.
steps: Whisk eggs with salt and black pepper.
Melt butter in a pan.
Pour in eggs and cook until nearly set.
Add cheddar, fold, and finish cooking.
Serve warm.

title: Tomato basil eggs
description: Eggs cooked with tomato and basil.
steps: Sauté garlic in olive oil for 30 seconds.
Add tomato and salt; cook 8 minutes.
Crack in eggs and cook until set.
Finish with basil and serve.

title: Cottage cheese bowl
description: Cottage cheese with honey and lemon.
steps: Add cottage cheese to a bowl.
Drizzle with honey and lemon juice.
Serve.

title: French toast
description: Bread dipped in egg and milk, pan-fried with cinnamon.
steps: Whisk eggs, milk, sugar, and cinnamon.
Dip bread slices in the mixture.
Cook in butter until golden on both sides.
Serve warm.

title: Banana oatmeal
description: Oatmeal with banana and cinnamon.
steps: Simmer oats with milk and a pinch of salt until thick.
Slice banana.
Serve oatmeal topped with banana and cinnamon.

title: Berry pancakes
description: Pancakes with blueberries mixed into the batter.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk milk and egg; combine with dry ingredients.
Fold in blueberries.
Cook pancakes in a lightly buttered pan until golden.

title: Eggs and spinach toast
description: Toast topped with sautéed spinach and a fried egg.
steps: Toast bread.
Sauté spinach in olive oil until wilted; season.
Fry eggs to your preference.
Top toast with spinach and eggs and serve.

title: Yogurt and banana bowl
description: Yogurt with banana and honey.
steps: Add yogurt to a bowl.
Top with sliced banana.
Drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Cheddar breakfast quesadilla
description: Quick tortilla with melted cheddar and scrambled eggs.
steps: Scramble eggs in butter; season with salt.
Place tortilla in a pan and add cheddar and eggs.
Top with second tortilla and cook until cheese melts.
Slice and serve.

title: Tomato cucumber breakfast salad
description: Simple morning salad with tomato and cucumber.
steps: Chop tomato and cucumber.
Dress with olive oil and salt.
Toss and serve.

title: Garlic mushroom toast
description: Toast topped with buttery garlic mushrooms.
steps: Toast bread.
Sauté mushrooms in butter until browned.
Add garlic and salt; cook 1 minute.
Top toast with mushrooms and finish with parsley.

title: Cinnamon honey toast
description: Toast with butter, honey, and cinnamon.
steps: Toast bread.
Spread butter on toast.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle cinnamon.
Serve.

title: Chocolate brownies
description: Rich chocolate brownies with cocoa powder.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C.
Melt butter and mix with sugar, eggs, and vanilla extract.
Stir in flour, cocoa powder, and salt.
Bake until set in the center.
Cool and slice.

title: Vanilla cupcakes
description: Simple vanilla cupcakes.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C and line a muffin tray.
Beat butter and sugar until fluffy.
Add eggs, then milk and vanilla extract.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Apple cinnamon crumble
description: Warm apple bake with cinnamon and buttery crumble.
steps: Preheat oven to 190В°C.
Slice apple and toss with lemon juice, sugar, and cinnamon.
Rub butter into flour to make crumbs.
Top apples with crumble.
Bake until golden and bubbling.

title: Lemon yogurt cake
description: Moist cake with yogurt and lemon.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C.
Whisk eggs and sugar until pale.
Add yogurt, olive oil, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Bake until set and golden.

title: Chocolate pudding
description: Creamy chocolate pudding made on the stovetop.
steps: Whisk milk with sugar, cocoa powder, flour, and salt.
Cook over medium heat, whisking, until thick.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla extract.
Chill before serving.

title: Strawberry yogurt parfait
description: Layered yogurt with strawberries and honey.
steps: Slice strawberries.
Layer yogurt and strawberries in glasses.
Drizzle with honey and top with walnuts.
Serve chilled.

title: Banana bread
description: Moist banana bread with vanilla and cinnamon.
steps: Preheat oven to 175В°C.
Mash banana and mix with sugar, eggs, melted butter, and vanilla extract.
Fold in flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Bake until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool before slicing.

title: Simple sugar cookies
description: Buttery sugar cookies with vanilla.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C.
Cream butter and sugar, then add egg and vanilla extract.
Mix in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Shape cookies and bake until lightly golden.
Cool before serving.

title: Chocolate chip cookies
description: Cookies loaded with chocolate pieces.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C.
Cream butter and sugar; add egg and vanilla extract.
Mix in flour, baking powder, and salt.
Fold in chopped chocolate.
Bake until edges are set.

title: Cocoa mug cake
description: Quick single-serve cocoa cake in a mug.
steps: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a mug.
Stir in milk and olive oil until smooth.
Microwave until set.
Cool briefly and serve.

title: Rice pudding
description: Creamy rice pudding with milk and cinnamon.
steps: Simmer rice with milk and salt until rice is tender.
Stir frequently to prevent sticking.
Add sugar and vanilla extract and cook 5 minutes.
Serve with cinnamon.

title: Lemon honey sorbet style
description: Simple lemon and honey frozen dessert.
steps: Heat water and dissolve honey, then cool.
Add lemon juice and mix well.
Freeze, stirring occasionally until slushy and smooth.
Serve cold.

title: Strawberry compote
description: Warm strawberry compote with lemon.
steps: Combine strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice in a pot.
Simmer until syrupy.
Cool slightly and serve.

title: Blueberry compote
description: Quick blueberry compote for yogurt or pancakes.
steps: Combine blueberries, sugar, and lemon juice in a pot.
Simmer until thickened.
Cool and serve.

title: Chocolate banana smoothie
description: Banana smoothie with cocoa and milk.
steps: Blend banana with milk, cocoa powder, and honey until smooth.
Pour into glasses.
Serve cold.

title: Baked apples with honey
description: Baked apples flavored with cinnamon and honey.
steps: Preheat oven to 190В°C.
Core apples and place in a baking dish.
Add a little butter, honey, and cinnamon to each apple.
Bake until tender.
Serve warm.

title: Walnut honey bars
description: Chewy bars with walnuts and honey.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C.
Mix butter, sugar, honey, and egg.
Fold in flour, baking powder, salt, and walnuts.
Bake until set and golden.
Cool and slice.

title: Cinnamon sugar donuts style
description: Baked donut-style treats coated with cinnamon sugar.
steps: Preheat oven to 180В°C.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter; combine with dry ingredients.
Bake in a donut pan or muffin tray until set.
Coat with cinnamon sugar while warm.

title: Chicken noodle soup
description: Comforting chicken soup with noodles and carrot.
steps: Simmer chicken breast in water until cooked; remove and shred.
Add chopped carrot, celery, onion, and garlic; simmer until tender.
Add noodles and cook until done.
Return chicken to the pot and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve with parsley.

title: Tomato basil soup
description: Smooth tomato soup finished with basil.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato, salt, and black pepper; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in basil and serve.

title: Mushroom soup
description: Creamy mushroom soup with garlic and parsley.
steps: Sauté onion and mushroom in butter until browned.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute.
Add milk gradually and simmer until thickened.
Add garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Serve with parsley.

title: Lentil soup
description: Lentil soup with carrot, celery, and tomato.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato, lentils, salt, and water.
Simmer until lentils are tender.
Serve hot.

title: Potato leek soup style
description: Creamy potato soup with onion and milk.
steps: Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Add diced potato and cover with water; simmer until tender.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in milk and warm through; season.
Serve hot.

title: Vegetable soup with beans
description: Brothy vegetable soup with beans and tomato.
steps: Simmer carrot, celery, onion, and garlic until tender.
Add tomato and simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans, salt, and cook 10 minutes.
Serve with parsley.

title: Chicken and rice soup
description: Light chicken soup with rice and carrot.
steps: Simmer chicken breast until cooked; shred.
Add chopped carrot, onion, and celery; simmer until tender.
Add rice and cook until tender.
Return chicken and season with salt and black pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Broccoli soup
description: Creamy broccoli soup with cheddar.
steps: Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Simmer broccoli in water until tender.
Blend broccoli with cooking liquid until smooth.
Stir in milk, cheddar, and salt; warm through.
Serve hot.

title: Cabbage soup
description: Simple cabbage soup with carrot and tomato.
steps: Simmer onion and carrot until slightly tender.
Add cabbage and tomato and simmer 20 minutes.
Add garlic and salt and cook 5 minutes.
Serve hot.

title: Creamy tomato soup
description: Tomato soup finished with heavy cream.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft.
Add tomato and simmer 20 minutes; season.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and warm through.
Serve hot.

title: Chickpea soup with garlic
description: Simple chickpea soup with onion and garlic.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add chickpeas and water; simmer 20 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Serve with parsley.

title: Minestrone style soup
description: Vegetable soup with beans and pasta.
steps: Simmer carrot, celery, and onion until tender.
Add tomato and simmer 15 minutes.
Add beans and penne; cook until pasta is tender.
Season with salt and serve with parsley.

title: Spinach soup with egg
description: Light spinach soup finished with egg.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add water and bring to a simmer.
Add spinach and cook 3 minutes.
Whisk in egg slowly while stirring.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Carrot ginger soup style
description: Smooth carrot soup with onion and milk.
steps: Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Simmer carrot in water until tender.
Blend until smooth.
Stir in milk and season with salt.
Warm through and serve.

title: Beef and barley soup style
description: Hearty soup with beef, onion, and barley.
steps: Simmer beef in water until tender.
Add barley, onion, carrot, and celery.
Cook until barley is tender.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Serve hot.

title: Creamy corn soup
description: Creamy corn soup with milk and onion.
steps: Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Add corn and water; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend partially for texture.
Stir in milk, salt, and black pepper; warm through.
Serve hot.

title: Tomato and cabbage soup
description: Brothy soup with tomato and cabbage.
steps: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic.
Add tomato and simmer 10 minutes.
Add cabbage and water; simmer until tender.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Potato and broccoli soup
description: Smooth soup with potato and broccoli.
steps: Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Simmer potato in water until tender.
Add broccoli and cook until tender.
Blend until smooth and stir in milk and salt.
Warm through and serve.

title: Chicken tomato rice soup
description: Chicken soup with tomato and rice.
steps: Simmer chicken breast until cooked; shred.
Sauté onion and garlic briefly, then add to the pot.
Add tomato and rice; simmer until rice is tender.
Return chicken, season with salt, and serve.

title: Greek salad
description: Salad with tomato, cucumber, onion, and feta.
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, and onion.
Add feta and toss gently.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar.
Season with oregano, salt, and serve.

title: Caesar salad style
description: Romaine-style salad with chicken and parmesan.
steps: Cook chicken breast and slice.
Mix mayonnaise with garlic and lemon juice; season.
Toss lettuce with dressing.
Top with chicken and parmesan.
Serve.

title: Tuna salad
description: Tuna salad with lettuce, cucumber, and onion.
steps: Chop lettuce, cucumber, and onion.
Add tuna and toss.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Chickpea salad
description: Chickpeas with tomato, cucumber, and parsley.
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, onion, and parsley.
Combine with chickpeas.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Cabbage slaw with mayonnaise
description: Cabbage slaw with carrot and mayonnaise dressing.
steps: Shred cabbage and grate carrot.
Mix mayonnaise with vinegar, salt, and black pepper.
Toss vegetables with dressing.
Chill briefly and serve.

title: Potato salad
description: Potato salad with onion and yogurt dressing.
steps: Boil potato until tender; cool and cube.
Mix yogurt with mustard, vinegar, and salt.
Toss potato with onion and dressing.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

title: Egg salad
description: Simple egg salad with mayonnaise and mustard.
steps: Boil eggs, cool, and chop.
Mix mayonnaise with mustard, salt, and black pepper.
Toss eggs with onion and dressing.
Serve.

title: Spinach salad with feta
description: Spinach salad with feta and lemon dressing.
steps: Combine spinach and feta in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice.
Add walnuts and a pinch of salt.
Toss and serve.

title: Tomato mozzarella salad
description: Tomato and mozzarella salad with basil and olive oil.
steps: Slice tomato and mozzarella.
Arrange on a plate and add basil.
Drizzle with olive oil.
Season with salt and black pepper and serve.

title: Cucumber yogurt salad
description: Cucumber salad with yogurt, garlic, and dill.
steps: Slice cucumber.
Mix yogurt with garlic and salt.
Toss cucumber with yogurt dressing and dill.
Serve chilled.

title: Corn and tomato salad
description: Corn salad with tomato, onion, and vinegar.
steps: Combine corn with chopped tomato and onion.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and serve.

title: Bean salad
description: Beans with onion, parsley, and olive oil.
steps: Slice onion and chop parsley.
Combine beans, onion, and parsley.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar and season with salt.
Serve.

title: Carrot raisin salad
description: Carrot salad with raisins and honey.
steps: Grate carrot.
Add raisins.
Mix yogurt with honey and lemon juice.
Toss and serve.

title: Broccoli salad with yogurt
description: Broccoli salad with yogurt, lemon, and walnuts.
steps: Blanch broccoli for 2 minutes and cool.
Mix yogurt with lemon juice and salt.
Toss broccoli with dressing and walnuts.
Serve.

title: Chicken salad with cucumber
description: Chicken breast salad with cucumber and yogurt dressing.
steps: Cook chicken breast and slice.
Chop cucumber and lettuce.
Mix yogurt with mustard and salt.
Toss everything together and serve.

title: Salmon salad
description: Salmon salad with lettuce and lemon dressing.
steps: Cook salmon and flake into pieces.
Chop lettuce and cucumber.
Dress with olive oil and lemon juice; season.
Top salad with salmon and serve.

title: Warm mushroom salad
description: Warm mushrooms over lettuce with vinegar dressing.
steps: Sauté mushrooms in olive oil until browned.
Add garlic and salt; cook 1 minute.
Toss lettuce with vinegar and a little olive oil.
Top with warm mushrooms and serve.

title: Potato and egg salad
description: Potato and egg salad with mayonnaise and onion.
steps: Boil potato until tender; cool and cube.
Boil eggs, cool, and chop.
Mix mayonnaise with salt and black pepper.
Toss potato, eggs, and onion with dressing.
Serve.

title: Simple garden salad
description: Everyday salad with lettuce, tomato, and cucumber.
steps: Chop lettuce, tomato, and cucumber.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar.
Season with salt and toss.
Serve.

title: Simple pancakes with honey
description: Pancakes served with honey.
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, and sugar.
Whisk milk and egg; combine with dry ingredients.
Cook pancakes in a lightly buttered pan until golden.
Serve with honey.

title: Tomato basil pasta salad
description: Cold pasta salad with tomato, basil, and olive oil.
steps: Boil farfalle until al dente; cool.
Chop tomato and basil.
Toss pasta with tomato, basil, olive oil, vinegar, and salt.
Serve chilled.

title: Vegetarian pasta with tomato and spinach
description: Penne with tomato and spinach in olive oil.
steps: Boil penne in salted water until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil for 30 seconds.
Add tomato and simmer 8 minutes; season.
Add spinach until wilted.
Toss with pasta and serve.

title: Beef burger patties
description: Pan-seared ground beef patties seasoned simply.
steps: Season ground beef with salt and black pepper.
Shape into patties.
Sear in olive oil until cooked through.
Rest 2 minutes and serve.
